classification: mandatory multi-pass evidence and completion-gate reinforcement

round_limit_override.reason: The user explicitly requested another strengthened Skill revision and fresh rollout after reviewing the Round 3 failure.

round_3_evidence.execution: 21 of 60 iterations, 21 provider requests, and 20 completed tool calls; normal end_turn with no infrastructure or verifier error
round_3_evidence.official_first_error: A single OCR pass misread one digit in a date and the agent accepted the first syntactically valid date without independent confirmation.
round_3_evidence.offline_full_comparison: Diagnostic full-row comparison found five wrong fields: three single-pass date recognition errors and two monetary semantic/fallback errors.
round_3_evidence.trajectory_diagnosis: The agent partially implemented total enumeration and table-heading filtering, but used only one OCR pass per image, stored no pass/raw-line/semantic/rejection provenance, retained last-token and page-position shortcuts, did not save a candidate audit, and finished after schema and null checks.

targets.section: Blocking Evidence Gate for Exact Structured Fields / Multi-Pass OCR Strategy / Semantic Adjudication for Monetary Totals / Quality Self-Check
targets.description_skill_error: The previous candidate allowed additional OCR passes to remain conditional on an already-observed conflict, so a plausible but wrong single-pass date could be accepted without creating the evidence needed to reveal disagreement. Its implementation gate also remained too easy to replace with schema and non-null checks.
targets.gold_repair: Require at least two materially different OCR observations for every non-null exact date and monetary field; require a targeted third pass for any disagreement; collect all date and amount candidates before selection; reject item/payment next-line fallbacks; preserve full per-candidate provenance and rejection reasons; and block completion unless executable audit assertions prove all winners have independent support and exactly match the reopened artifact.

leakage_controls.notes: The Skill contains only task-general OCR reliability and semantic-selection rules. Sample filenames, concrete outputs, oracle values, and verifier row numbers remain outside the candidate Skill.

validation.trajectory_diagnosis: The agent partially adopted multi-pass OCR and required two distinct pass IDs for a normalized value, but did not require agreement on the same source region and semantic field. Targeted passes ran only when no winner existed, not when candidates disagreed. No candidate audit was persisted, safe next-line pairing remained incomplete, and the final check covered only workbook structure, row count, and ordering rather than the blocking evidence assertions.
validation.artifact_archive: The artifacts directory is empty. The live verifier successfully read and printed the complete workbook, so the failure verdict is valid, but the workbook itself is not independently archived.
validation.acceptance_boundary: A valid fresh reward-1 rollout is required before this extended candidate can be accepted as Gold.

final_attribution.label: agent_did_not_follow
final_attribution.reason: The repaired Skill was fully preloaded and materially changed the implementation, but the agent weakened or skipped the explicit disagreement retry, provenance, semantic adjudication, and executable completion-gate requirements, then ended after a structure-only check.
